name: kktest-dev
description: kktest-dev plugins for Claude Code & Cowork. Developer-grade automation, starting with memory-keeper.

plugins.name: memory-keeper
plugins.description: Keep file-based agent memory lean and durable: compact the index, archive done/stale memories to cold storage, and lint the index against a byte budget.

plugins.name: focus-notify
plugins.description: Focus-aware desktop notifications for Claude Code. Notify only when your terminal is NOT the frontmost app. Three kinds (finished, approve, question), each with its own message and sound, plus click-to-focus on macOS/Linux.

plugins.name: kkskills-essentials
plugins.description: Generic, project-agnostic working skills (4) that self-improve over time: additive-changes and no-duplicate-docs feedback discipline, proactive task reminders, and the Conventional Commits reference. Planning (plan-decompose-orchestrate) moved to kkskills-situational in 0.6.0 because it overlaps superpowers' planning skills. Situational skills live in kkskills-situational; personal/project-specific skills in kkskills-personal. Skills-only.

plugins.name: kkskills-situational
plugins.description: Situational working skills (10) — enable the plugin when the work calls for them: additive-first DB migrations, verify-with-real-data, clean-architecture, secret hygiene, concurrency/race-conditions, MCP server authoring, timezone handling, local-LLM selection, plan decomposition & orchestration (moved from kkskills-essentials in 0.2.0), and the meta-skill that folds new learnings back into a skill. Correct and maintained, just not everyday: every skill's description sits in context in every session, so these are kept behind one toggle. Skills-only.

plugins.name: kkskills-personal
plugins.description: Personal / project-specific working skills split out from kkskills-essentials: a user-profile calibration skill and a versioned-filename (DDMMYYYY_NAME.md) reference convention. Encodes one person's preferences and one project's conventions — fork and replace the specifics. Skills-only.

plugins.name: loop-ledger
plugins.description: A guardrail for agent loops: a deterministic state machine (budget + stall-hash + exit predicate) that decides should-continue per iteration, plus an opt-in Stop hook that enforces it so the agent can neither quit early nor spin forever. Zero-dependency MCP server.

plugins.name: reflexion
plugins.description: Self-improving agent memory built on memory-keeper: recall matching lessons before a task, reflect a new lesson after it, browse the error/success library, and compress recurring lessons into higher-level patterns.

plugins.name: critique-gate
plugins.description: A quality brake for agent output: generate, then a distinct critic role scores against a rubric and demands rewrites until the score clears a threshold or the retry budget (via loop-ledger) is exhausted. Four modes -- score-retry, multi-critic, adversarial, judge-ensemble. Skills-only; reuses loop-ledger's MCP tools and Stop hook for enforcement, no new server.

plugins.name: prompt-evolve
plugins.description: Evolve a prompt against a test set: run/score it, find where it fails, rewrite from those failures, repeat. Deterministic scorers (exact-match/regex/schema), saved agent rubric grades, plus a fully offline verification loop; stdlib CLI + skill, no model calls of its own.

plugins.name: agent-loops
plugins.description: Playbook for the 5 categories of agent loop design patterns (Quality, Memory, Planning, Exploration, System Optimization) — when to use each, its minimal shape, and the exact loop-ledger brake to wire (exit_mode/target_value/direction/max_iterations or dry_rounds). Includes a loop-selector router skill. Skills-only; pairs with the loop-ledger plugin for enforcement.

plugins.name: tool-metrics
plugins.description: Count Claude Code tool usage across all sessions: built-in tools, MCP tools by server, skill invocations, and subagent spawns — /tool-stats terminal table plus an HTML dashboard.

plugins.name: kktestdev-pack
plugins.description: Team onboarding pack: /kk-onboard inventories what you already have installed or connected, skips what is already there, audits existing skills/MCP/plugins/hooks for redundancy and risk, and asks you item by item (neutral pros and cons) what to install, keep, or remove. /kk-update pulls the latest of everything the pack manages. Installs nothing by itself.

plugins.name: infographic-diagram
plugins.description: Presentation-ready architecture, layer-stack and tech-stack diagrams as SVG (+ 2x PNG) from a JSON spec, in three looks: light system map, editorial numbered layer stack, dark neon category tree. A Python script owns layout, icons and arrow routing, with a lint pass for overlaps and overflow. Thai text supported.
